title: Answer Buyers on X in Your Own Voice
summary: Turn posts that show buying intent into replies you choose to post, drafted in your voice so you can answer while the buyer is still looking.

money_potential.label: Medium
money_potential.basis: Assumes you sell on X and get enquiries from posts; the value is faster replies, and you choose every post.
money_potential.note: Value tiers are our rough estimates (labelled Estimate) of relative value to the business, each with its assumption. They are not promises, income claims or advice. Results depend on your market, offer and effort.

how_it_makes_money: You answer buyers while they are still looking.
Drafts save time, but you choose and post every reply.
who_its_for: Consultants and agencies that get enquiries from posts.

steps.name: You

outputs: A short queue of buyer posts

steps: Set the phrases and topics that signal a buyer.
Review the queue in Slack each day.
Edit the drafts so they sound like you.
guardrails: You post every reply yourself. Nothing is sent or posted automatically.
Follow X rules on automation and unsolicited replies.
